verdict.rationale: Codegen's cloud agents can present a structured plan (codegen-docs-22) and ask for clarification and report progress in Slack (codegen-docs-2, codegen-docs-9), and paused runs can be resumed (codegen-docs-35). Together these suggest a PM could weigh in on decisions through Slack or Linear. Nothing in the evidence documents a mobile experience or a formal approve/reject gate, so phone-based approval is only implied by the Slack channel. missing for 10: explicit mobile app or mobile approval workflow, documented approval gates for key decisions, evidence that other agents keep working while one awaits approval, independent or hands-on corroboration.
